behaviorIdsFailed.description: Behavior ids whose intent the diff does not satisfy.

behaviorIdsPassed.description: Behavior ids whose intent the diff satisfies.

passed.description: Overall intent verdict: true only when the subtask intent and every relevant acceptance criterion are satisfied by the diff. Never reflects test/build/lint outcomes.

reasoning.description: Per-criterion rationale: cite each acceptance criterion / behavior and state whether the diff satisfies its intent. Do not assert or speculate about test/build/lint results.
